---

Note: per GradeWise's accuracy-first philosophy, a university will only get a verified formula once someone
(maintainer or contributor) actually locates and confirms an official source — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#academic-formula--university-data-contributions). Until then, the
institution may still be listed with no rule, or with a formula explicitly marked unverified.
